The CLI covers Unity Catalog objects and serverless GPU workload submission via `databricks air run`, and the API reference includes CLI examples; a probe confirms the official CLI docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, explicit agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or AI-agent integration guidance).
